name: parsing
rule: 09:00 rollover test passes; impossible-date rows logged; HIGHEST/LOWEST mismatch <= 1% of complete days per file (after tracing misreferenced sheet formulas); Aviles values in 9-14 m after /100 (>= 99% of readings; out-of-range readings set to NaN and logged)

evidence.hl_note: Mismatches above 1% were all traced to HIGHEST/LOWEST formulas that aggregate another day's row (source-sheet template error); the readings are in day order (continuity checked). A parser column shift would leave unexplained mismatches.
